content:
REQUIRED-QUESTION: I need to remove a documentation sidebar without flattening the table in the answer.

## Accepted answer

REQUIRED-ANSWER: Select the main content before serialization, then whitelist semantic table elements in the final sanitizer.

```
builder.add_tags(["table", "thead", "tbody", "tr", "th", "td"]);
```

REQUIRED-REPLY: Also test colspan and rowspan attributes.

metadata.title: How do I preserve table structure?
